title: Scenic Tour of Bryce Canyon
overview: See the best of Utah’s Bryce Canyon National Park on a small-group tour excursion. Set off for an adventure through the rugged landscapes and unique spires with a seasoned guide and an air-conditioned vehicle. Discover key sites in the park and learn about the wildlife, history, and geology of Bryce Canyon.

title: Bryce Canyon Private Tour
overview: Our little company is owned and operated by locals with unique insights to the park, its operation, and the surrounding areas. Through our years of experience, we've learned many different approaches to navigate Bryce's trails, as well as its parking lots. Join this 3-hour comprehensive mini bus tour to explore Bryce Canyon, and discover must-see sites while learning about the flora, fauna, history, and geology of one of the most uniquely beautiful landscapes in the world.

title: Hiking Experience in Bryce Canyon National Park
overview: Hike through the canyons and amphitheaters of Bryce Canyon on this small group guided tour. Your guide will fill you in on local stories, explaining what “hoodoos” are, and showing you some of the most scenic spots to hike through- and photograph. You’ll be provided with snacks and water along the way to keep you energized for the hike.
highlights: Keep costs down by joining this small group tour
Granola bars and fruit provided for you
Easy to meet departure location
Tour for around 5 hours, then the rest of the day is free

title: Bryce Canyon E-bike Tour
overview: Make the most of your visit to the park with the help of a guide who’ll take you to see some of the best of Bryce Canyon by bike. The tour leader will share their knowledge of the history, flora, fauna, and geology of the park. Pause the journey for a snack, courtesy of your guide, who’ll make sure you look out for local wildlife too.

title: Bryce Canyon National Park 15-Minute Helicopter Tour
overview: Experience the breathtaking beauty of Bryce Canyon National Park on a 15-minute panoramic helicopter tour designed for maximum impact in minimal time. Fly over iconic landmarks like Boat Mesa, Fairyland, and the Sinking Ship while your expert pilot shares insights into the park’s geology and natural history.
highlights: The aircraft does not have any provisions to store a wheel-chair, walking stick, or walking device(s).
Helicopter tours require a minimum of five (5) passengers to operate.
Passengers must provide a valid Government issued identification at the time of check-in. These include a State Drivers License or Passport.
At the time of booking, passengers must provide accurate body weights at the time of booking in Lbs, Kg’s or Stones.
Passengers exceeding 250 Lbs (113 kg) are required to purchase an additional seat at 100% of the tour retail price.

title: Bryce Canyon National Park 30-Minute Helicopter Tour
overview: Experience the breathtaking beauty of Bryce Canyon National Park from above on a 30-minute, 55-mile helicopter tour, departing from Bryce Canyon Airport. Soar past iconic landmarks like Rainbow Point, Natural Bridge, Boat Mesa, and Fairyland, with stunning views of remote ridges and ancient Bristlecone Pines rarely seen from the ground.
highlights: The aircraft does not have any provisions to store a wheel-chair, walking stick, or walking device(s).
Helicopter tours require a minimum of five (5) passengers to operate.
Passengers must provide a valid Government issued identification at the time of check-in. These include a State Drivers License or Passport.
At the time of booking, passengers must provide accurate body weights at the time of booking in Lbs, Kg’s or Stones.
Passengers exceeding 250 Lbs (113 kg) are required to purchase an additional seat at 100% of the tour retail price.

title: Bryce Canyon Stargazing Adventure
overview: Explore the wonders of the universe on this Bryce Canyon Stargazing Tour, led by expert guides eager to share the mysteries of the night sky. Begin with a brief orientation before engaging with state-of-the-art telescopes to identify constellations, planets, and galaxies. Depending on the season, you’ll witness stunning celestial objects and have opportunities for deep-sky astrophotography.
highlights: Wheelchair accessible
We only pick up from two locations: Ruby's Inn and the Best Western Grand

title: Late Night Stargazing
overview: This unique experience offers unparalleled views of the night sky from a carefully chosen high vantage point away from campground lights and dust. Enjoy comfortable seating and blankets with uninterrupted stargazing using red-filtered lighting. Knowledgeable guides set up telescopes and prepare the viewing area for views of the Milky Way, distant galaxies, and celestial objects.
highlights: Prime visibility from a high vantage point away from campground lights and dust
Comfortable seating and blankets provided
Red-filtered lighting to minimize light pollution
Expert guidance with telescopes set up in advance

title: Bryce Canyon Photography Tours
overview: Sunrise Tour: If you want to experience the golden glow of sunrise in Bryce Canyon at the perfect spots and at the best times, this is the tour for you! As a local guide and professional photographer, you can expect only the best from each of these tours! Astro Tour: Witness some of the darkest night skies in the world!

title: Private Bryce Canyon and Slot Canyon Full Day Hike
overview: Join Sundial Guides on this 6-8 hour PRIVATE hiking adventure exploring two famous locations. Best way to explore Bryce Canyon National Park and surrounding Grand Staircase of Escalante National Monument in one full day. You will hike in Bryce and then travel by 4x4 to a less-visited slot canyon in the Grand Staircase.

title: Bryce Canyon Full Day Small Group Tour & Hike
overview: Embark on a captivating exploration of the unique landscapes of Bryce Canyon National Park with engaging small-group tours. Traverse amphitheaters of hoodoos and vibrant spires while expert guides share narratives and insights. Groups are capped at 8 hikers.
inclusions: We’ll have snacks and a selection of beverages available, but feel free to bring along any personal favorites you might crave during the day.

title: Peekaboo, Spooky and Dry Fork Slot Canyon Tour
overview: Discover the rugged landscape of the Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument with a guide on this small-group half-day tour. Let your guide worry about the route while you focus on having fun in this unique part of the world. Walk through a scenic terrain of red and purple rock, arches, and narrow slot openings, checking out slot canyons such as Peek-a-Boo and Spooky Gulch.
highlights: Travel time is included on the total tour duration.
inclusions: We will provide some water, but guests should bring their own as well.

title: Half Day Canyoneering Tour in Egypt Slot Canyon
overview: Egypt 1 offers a lot packed into a short approach and exit. Those with high skill levels can downclimb the entire canyon. Others will do 3 short rappels.
highlights: Travel time is included on the total tour duration.

title: Ruby's Horseback Adventures Utah 1.5 Hour Ride
overview: Saddle up and get ready to ride through some of the most beautiful scenery southern Utah has to offer. Listen as your guide tells stories about the area, including tales of wild west outlaws and the Native Americans who once inhabited these lands. Rides are appropriate for all skill levels, but due to the terrain, riders must be at least seven years old to participate.
highlights: Go on a guided horseback ride in Bryce Canyon National Park
Enjoy fantastic scenery and views as you ride through the park
All skill levels welcome on this family friendly experience
Choose from morning to late afternoon ride times when booking
inclusions: Guided Horse Ride with wonderful scenery.

title: Ruby's Horseback Adventures Utah Half Day Ride
overview: If you've always wanted to hop on a horse, don't miss this beginner-friendly, half-day horseback riding excursion in Utah's scenic Red Canyon. Follow your guide along some famous rugged trails, past old Native American ruins, and through the red rock canyon. With more than 6 miles (9.6 kilometers) to cover, this tour is a great way to get the hang of riding.
inclusions: Guided Horse Ride with wonderful scenery.

title: Ruby's Horseback Adventures Utah Thunder Mt. 4 Hour Ride
overview: Get away from the park crowds on this epic four-hour tour on horseback. With the Bryce Canyon area as your backdrop, you’ll clip-clop along Old West trails used by both cowboys and Indigenous groups, climbing up and down the scenic Red Canyon. Appropriate for beginners to experts, this ride truly goes off the beaten path for serious canyon adventure.
inclusions: Guided Horse Ride with wonderful scenery.

title: One Hour Guided ATV Ride in Utah
overview: Discover the beauty of Bryce Canyon National Park on a thrilling ATV ride. Follow your guide and a small group through ponderosa pine forests and mountainous landscapes in your own ATV. Travel across rugged trails and stop at points that many people miss.

title: Horseback Riding Experience through Red Canyon with a Guide
overview: Ride a horse through the same wild landscape where Butch Cassidy once roamed, on a guided trail ride that's suited to all experience levels. With a cowboy or cowgirl guide to lead the way, you’ll learn the fascinating history of the Bryce Canyon area. Follow narrow trails featuring gorgeous views for an experience you can’t get from the road.
highlights: Guided trail ride can be tailored to your experience level
Get paired with a horse that’s suited to you
Meet a real cowboy or cowgirl working in the Utah desert
Convenient departure point located on Route 12
